capabilities: Edit Markdown notes stored outside the vault
Paste images with correct relative paths
Move notes with attachments in or out of the vault
Rewrite links automatically when moving notes
Insert links to external notes from inside the vault
disambiguation: Not a vault-syncing tool; it edits individual Markdown files in up to two configured external directories.
extras: Desktop only, requires Obsidian 1.14+; no network requests or telemetry; file access limited to the two configured directories; source files removed only after target files are verified on disk.
problem: Obsidian only works with notes inside the vault, so notes kept elsewhere cannot be edited, pasted into, or moved without breaking links and attachments.

relations.evidence: opens a real preview of the external file in Hover Editor or the native page preview

summary: Edits Markdown notes stored outside the vault, with relative-path image pasting, attachment-aware moves, and links back into Obsidian.
